faq.subtitle: How your private AI works, where data is stored, and how it accelerates your team.
faq.q1: What is <brand></brand> and how does it work?
faq.a1: aiOFFICE is your company's private AI model and central knowledge base. It indexes your internal documents, contracts, regulations, and CRM processes to answer employee questions instantly in Telegram and Slack.
faq.q2: How is aiOFFICE different from standard ChatGPT?
faq.a2: A general-purpose assistant does not know your internal rules. aiOFFICE is configured around the sources you approve and can show the source reference where that feature is included in the agreed scope.
faq.q3: Which communication channels and CRMs can it connect to?
faq.a3: aiOFFICE integrates with Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, Bitrix24, HubSpot, email, and any custom internal software via API.
faq.q4: How does it automate employee onboarding?
faq.a4: New hires can ask any question in chat from day one and receive instant, verified answers regarding company policies, pricing, order processing, and rules without interrupting managers.
faq.q5: Where is company confidential data stored?
faq.a5: The agreed project setup defines access, retention, storage and any external processing needed for the selected function. Do not upload information that is unnecessary for the task.
faq.q6: How does the AI model update when new rules or contracts are added?
faq.a6: aiOFFICE operates with 24/7 continuous synchronization: as soon as a new document is uploaded, the AI model updates its knowledge within seconds.
faq.q7: Can it enforce discount limits and return policies?
faq.a7: Yes, the AI strictly follows company policies: it informs employees of allowable volume discounts and indicates when commercial director approval is required.
faq.q8: What happens if an employee asks something not in the documents?
faq.a8: The AI never fabricates answers. It transparently states that the information was not found in the verified database and escalates the query to the designated manager.
faq.q9: How does aiOFFICE differ from aiDOCS, aiSTAFF, and aiCALL?
faq.a9: aiOFFICE handles internal knowledge and employee onboarding; aiDOCS processes accounting documents (RS.ge, ORIS, 1C); aiSTAFF manages customer-facing website chat; aiCALL handles automated voice phone calls.
faq.a10: Initial document audit, knowledge indexing, model training, and chat integration are typically completed within a few business days.
faq.q11: Can we configure different access levels for employees?
faq.a11: Yes, you can define granular permissions (e.g. financial metrics restricted to executives, while sales guidelines are available to all representatives).
faq.q12: What happens if our company changes its CRM or chat app?
faq.a12: The AI model is independent and preserves your central knowledge. If you migrate to a new CRM or workspace, the AI connects to the new system seamlessly.
faq.q13: Does this replace managers or employees?
faq.a13: No, aiOFFICE eliminates repetitive questions and document searching, allowing your team to focus on sales, operations, and business growth.
faq.q14: What languages does the model support?
faq.a14: Georgian, English, and Russian, based on your company's documents and team communication preference.
faq.q15: How is the return on investment measured?
faq.a15: By reducing onboarding ramp-up time by 80%, eliminating operational delays, and saving 10+ hours of managerial time per week previously spent on repetitive answers.
faq.q16: How do we get started with aiOFFICE?
faq.a16: Leave your contact number. aiNOW will review your files, demonstrate the AI model on your actual workflows, and deploy your corporate AI within days.

capabilities.title: What aiOFFICE fixes in everyday office work
capabilities.intro: Ten common office problems are reduced through five simple working systems.

1.title: No lost requests or unclear owners
1.description: Collects tasks from different channels and assigns each task to a responsible person with a deadline.
1.result: Every request has a visible owner and next step.

2.title: No missed deadlines or forgotten follow-ups
2.description: Sends reminders, escalates overdue work, and turns meeting decisions into assigned follow-up tasks.
2.result: Important work does not disappear after a meeting or busy day.

3.title: No document chaos or wrong versions
3.description: Keeps files with the correct task, shows the current version, and requests missing information.
3.result: The team works from the same document and sees its status.

4.title: No stalled approvals or status chasing
4.description: Routes approvals, records decisions, reminds the right person, and shows where work is blocked.
4.result: Managers see the bottleneck without asking every employee.

5.title: No manual weekly reports or repeated searching
5.description: Builds daily and weekly summaries and finds approved internal information from the connected workspace.
5.result: The manager gets a clear update without another spreadsheet.
